notes.title: CYBERLOG #16 - End Of Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Fans,

We wanted to thank you very much for all the kind words you sent us regarding our game during Steam Next Fest, if you wish to try Demo you will have a chance to do so for the next few weeks. It means a lot 
to hear you enjoyed playing our game, espacially after all the changes we made to the game. 

Like many of you noticed there have been significant changes to game design and look, but worry not, they were all made to make our game play better and to narrow down on specific aspects. We decided to shift focus from regular RTS title and change it into a City Builder as we feel it is a niche that not many games are covering and one that can be a great fun if done properly. 

We are listening to all your feedbacks and are ready to make changes based on them, because it is you, the players, we are making this game for. So you can all expect multiple Devlogs in the upcoming weeks, covering all the important gameplay mechanics of our games and why we decided to make the this way.

So be sure to add our game to your Steam Wishlist to not miss any new info, also remember to test our Demo if you have not already.

It will be all for now, we also want to wish you a Happy Valentines Days, hope you spend it with your loved ones and have a great time.

See you soon,
CyberGames

Hello Cybers!

We're back after a long break. Recently, our cyber team has been working on new buildings in the game. We would like to show you some examples of buildings that will be available for building cities in the game.

[b]Poor residential building[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/69e4115c5a2a4b104bdb762088fbe902ee9b2889.png[/img]

Best,
CyberTeam

notes.title: Cyberlog #11 Big city life
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Cybers! [/h1]

Do you know what makes the city live? People 😊 If it wasn't for them the city would not be developing. In CyberTown people are as important as other resources that you collect . 


CITY IS PEOPLE

CyberTown citizens define our city value. As a player, you can build different types of buildings, such as factories, corporate skyscrapers, laboratories or civilian buildings. By creating more buildings of a given type, more representatives of a given community start to appear on the streets. This affects the morale of our city and the relations between individual residents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/c18c18201dfa48756e7cc32e46a84c52abed6642.png[/img]

CORPORATE LIFE

The first group of citizens are people working in corporations. These are people who need to focus on their work. They mainly deal with the preparation of commercial offers and production management in udimentium factories and mines.
Corportaion buildings should usually be located close to warehouses and factories in order to control stocks of valuable raw materials. This speeds up many procedures related to manufacturing modules and overall production management. At the same time, the proximity of industrial buildings negatively affects the well-being of employees. It results in lower work efficiency and signing less profitable commercial contracts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/af80875bcbcf4724193f4a3278caaa75ecefcaab.jpg[/img]

The above-described dependencies introduce mechanics in the game that the player must learn in order for his city to function properly. In the future logs we’re going to discuss other relationships between building categories in CyberTown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/5e9713d479038d35b114872768b1b8ee21ea053b.jpg[/img]

What do you think about our game? Feel free to share your opinions and suggestions at our discord channel:

notes.title: Cyberlog #10 Lesser evil
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Cybers! [/h1]

In the previous log, we mentioned several building categories in CyberTown and the interactions between them. Today we cover the industrial district and its associated buildings.

[b]YOUR MAIN INCOME[/b]

The industrial district is an important part of our city. It is here that raw materials are mined, thanks to which we can trade and develop our metropolis. In CyberTown, the player will have to build a lot of buildings that process resources. Unfortunately, they pose a significant threat to the environment and people, which means that they are best built outside the city center. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/44cae68d5465813f8c37d386048779ee824c6ee9.png[/img]

At the same time, employees require constant supervision by the management staff, a large amount of food, as well as workers' estates near the factories. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/facf9f0cae659cadbc477b89d03d9210dc89a1b5.jpg[/img]

[b]KEEP UP MOTIVATED[/b]

It is up to the player, among other things, whether he decides to increase the efficiency of the workers extracting the udimentium at the expense of the well-being of the managers of the corporation blowing the toxic fumes of the factories. The constant balancing between more or less wrong choices is motivated by keeping the city on a new planet and independence from debilitating and ruthless corporations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/896d0817c589cd6e600a22ee87c2dc92054afd57.jpg[/img]

What do you think about CyberTown? Feel free to share your opinions and suggestions at our discord channel:

notes.title: Cyberlog #9 Times change
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Cybers! [/h1]

Welcome to the new log from our game development. We’ve already mentioned something about CyberTown. You should know that Udimentium is the most valuable resource in our world and the Industrial District is a place that never sleeps.  What is it all about?

[b]ALL ABOUT MONEY[/b]

Today we're going to reveal some inconvenient facts about our Town. The first is: who has the gold makes the rules. This time it is a Titan. Global corporation that supports your city in the new technologies that allow you to gain more resources and literally develop CyberTown into CyberCity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/09a69bf934960b720cf885724ce90161a2b89cf5.jpg[/img]

Despite the fact that Titan gives people the opportunity to work, and also provides modern technological and medical support, some citizens rebel against the actions of this corporation. If it were possible, they would gladly return to farming and food trade, which used to be popular in these regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/62156d4e0c51ebeec7abf811d65b6ef6eae16f99.jpg[/img]

[b]URBAN LIFE[/b]

New times have come. Agricultural lands began to transform into cybernetic metropolises full of corporate factories, office buildings and laboratories. One of them is CyberTown, another region that Titan has helped with technological development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/7e3681e04db3d440a8f9b9289e307da25e563da3.png[/img]

Let us know what you think about CyberTown. Feel free to share your opinions and suggestions at our discord channel:

Be up to date with the latest updates and visit our social media profiles.

notes.title: Cyberlog #8 Colonization Center
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Cybers! [/h1]

As always we would love to share some news from our Town. Today we present to you a few screens from actual gameplay that we’re already testing.

[b]ONE TO MANAGE THEM ALL[/b]

The triangular shaped  building you can see below is the Colonization Center. That's the main structure we start the game with. The first building that player interacts with.  It’s used for managing our population count. As our city is just growing up we have to settle it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/7fc60f9f37ffa6ee84ef9d8b4cd504b525769a62.png[/img]

The Colonization Center allows us to choose who is going to live in the Town, offering newcomers an attractive job and salary. This way player can decide how many workers, scientists or other social classes live here. The variety of citizens is a very important part of core gameplay. Every class of newcomers is needed in the right proportion to properly run the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/fd2314294568b842a11d2d91db5902dabf8706fc.png[/img]

[b]LAST NOT LEAST[/b]

Bringing in the residents to our Town is not the only function of the Colonization Center. It also stores some energy reserves  that can supply our city center.Unfortunately we're running out of these reserves very fast. It makes us to invest in mining resources like Udimentium that can be processed in energy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/735bc926c48785052942e6e52dc8983b68698cdc.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyberlog #5 Trade Center
notes.notes:
Hello Cybers!
This time we’re going to write a few words about one of the most important buildings in CyberTown. The Trade Center.


[h1]TIME IS MONEY[/h1]

Main economics of CyberTown is based on trade. On the new discovered planet we’re mining extraordinary material called udimentium. It can be practically turned into anything.With udimentium factories produce highly durable building materials, weapons, appliances, and even cosmetics and medicines. These are export goods that CyberTown can trade with other colonies or, mainly, with Earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/a69dd885f8412e82116b7e338dfb1721dd872e04.png[/img]

[h1]HEART OF BUSINESS[/h1]

Selling udimentium allows our corporation to develop the city. Credits we receive from the Earth is our main currency that is used for recruiting new citizens willing to settle in CyberTown. We offer them a specific amount of monthly and welcome salary.
The Trade Center is the main building in the corporational district. You can set the price of your udimentium goods there and sign up a delivery contract with other colonies and Earth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/9dadb7a2fe570bfc83c567c978cc584d909e3a40.png[/img]

Let us know what you think about our work. Feel free to share with us your ideas and suggestions here, in the comments or at our discord channel:

notes.title: Cyberlog #4| Entertainment District
notes.notes:
Hello Cybers!
This week we want to show you a little bit of the place that unites all citizens. It is the entertainment district in CyberTown.

[h1]CITY THAT NEVER SLEEPS[/h1]

As always we’ve started from the idea. The city can be easily divided into separate districts playing different roles in the life of our cyber society. In the previous logs, we described to you the industrial district that provides most of the citizens work. It’s more than obvious these people need a rest, afterwork life and a place to socialize with each other. 

Life on the new discovered planet is growing fast. The city center started to evolve in the meeting place. Various bars, restaurants and clubs are here just to give people a little substitute for life on Earth. There are few drafts for concept illustration below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/e749b0b2917ddef2075e93bdcd103aa3de9ab63a.png[/img]

[h1]WORK - LIFE BALANCE[/h1]

Every worker has his own needs. To be more effective he must reduce stress and relax after work. As a player in CyberTown you’ll have to take care of your people and make sure they have a chance to fulfill all needs. Do they live close enough to other people? Do they have the opportunity to visit their favourite clubs and restaurants? Are there any means of transport to them? All of these things can increase life satisfaction in your city and make you a good administrator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/3de39d851f356f430aadc47d9d1c590c0f49b55c.jpg[/img]

Let us know what you think about our work. Feel free to share with us your ideas and suggestions here, in the comments or at our discord channel:

notes.title: Cyberlog #3 | Udimentium Factory
notes.notes:
Hello Cybers!
Today we present to you the designing process of buildings in CyberTown. The place we start from is an Udimentium Factory.

[h1]VALUABLE RESOURCES[/h1]
 Last time we mentioned udimentium as one of the most crucial resources in our world. It is mined from the roots of holy trees, deep below the surface. It makes udimentium rare, but powerful as there are not too many places where it can be found. 
Udimentium can supply the whole city with electricity. It can be also transported to the factory and processed into different materials, device or weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/6b8131da35ebe71f066bebc5185c6f1314365874.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/94810eedf030c614869f747f9b363ffa9d5efc6a.png[/img]

[h1]SET UP THE MOOD[/h1]
We start the designing process with getting into the mood. The building you can see on concept art below is the same factory you might have seen on the illustration in our first log. We’ve started from the illustration to set up the mood of the industrial district, the area devoted to frustrated  workers striving to earn their living in harsh conditions. Then we tried to focus on a general visualization of buildings in the industrial area. We defined them as heavy and smoked with a violet-blue lightning (the udimentium colors).  Preparing the factory model we arrange the space around it, so that player would notice the daily duties of workers and their behaves. We want buildings to be vibrant with life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/ccc8f75a22782b51727c689e0b829adb45ea53ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Cyberlog #2 | Industrial City
notes.notes:
Today we're going to take a look at the key area in our city - the Industrial District.

In [b]CyberTown[/b], resources are the greatest value, especially udimentium. It allows our colony not only to develop new technologies, but it also supplies the entire city with energy. The wide range of udimentium applications makes it also the main export commodity to Earth.

[h1]Place to work, not to live[/h1]

The industrial district is the first part of the city we want to focus on. Our [b]CyberTown [/b]would not function without this area. The entire economy is based mainly on the extraction of udimentium and regent. It is here that all resources will be mined, stored and processed into advanced building materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/cde0fb650d084eed5a50298b585b80ade34b934a.png[/img]

The district is away from the city center because of the strong lightning strikes often attracted by huge tin buildings. That makes this place not safe for the average citizen. A thick, purple smoke constantly rises from the factory chimneys polluting the air with melted udimentium, which demands workers to wear protective masks.

Work in an industrial area requires high resistance to harsh conditions including intense heat, pollution and physical effort. That’s why most industrial workers are equipped with bionic body parts and implants.

[h1]From the scratch[/h1]

Designing this specific area we try to understand the universe of [b]CyberTown[/b]. Our city connects different groups of people with completely different ideological views. These differences define the characteristics of each district.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/86f92abca8dbb7ff61932b88735201772d16a084.png[/img]

In the following weeks we’re going to share with you more details about our [b]CyberTown [/b]world. Feel free to share with us your own suggestions and opinions on Steam or Discord. We’d be more than happy to get more inspiration from you!

notes.title: Cyberlog #1 | Welcome to Town
notes.notes:
Hello Cybers!

We are more than happy to post this very first log for developing [b]CyberTown[/b] game!  At this point our team is finally ready to share with you behind the scenes of the current project. Are you ready? 😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/6c19e385307d65ea4f490a8348743f6273cc9561.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is a CyberTown?[/b][/h1]

[b]CyberTown[/b] is a city building game with RTS elements that takes place in a world based on a cyberpunk culture.
It’s been a while since we have published the first trailer. For the last months we’ve focused on developing our game design elements as we'd love to highlight the future society structures, their economy, ideology and struggles on a new discovered planet in a dystopian city 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39931215/c077e7fc1300f26028099e2e5b4f0c92a0945e81.png[/img]

The future, that we know from the cyberpunk genre, is based on contrasts between diverse communities living together. In [b]CyberTown[/b] you will be able to get familiar with two dominating groups that are trying to take control over the city and colonize the whole planet. Your role is to build a consistent colony that will allow mankind to survive on new, undiscovered lands 🪐


[h1][b]Join our City![/b][/h1]

As our team wants to provide you with a possible best game, we invite you to join our community channels, where you will be able to help us make [b]CyberTown[/b] great! ⭐

Feel free to share with us your ideas, suggestions and own opinions about our work. We will regularly post update notes on the progress of [b]CyberTown[/b] production, so let’s stay tuned and honest!


Ask questions and share ideas on our discord community:
